title: Eleven Years of Quiet
subtitle: 基础与依据 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 基础与依据（生活与学习·协议与准则）
meta: 主题语境：基础与依据（生活与学习·协议与准则）　|　核心词汇：basis　|　正文 328 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 basis 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 my grandfather agreed to something on ① a basis he never wrote down, and my grandmother said the not writing was the whole of the arrangement. The ② basis, meaning the understanding and not the agreement, held for eleven years and was disputed in the twelfth; a basis, he said, is the only part of a promise that nobody reads.

Every ③ basis in that family was decided by whoever was oldest, and the ④ basis for the 1961 split, meaning the one about the shop and not either of those, was still being argued in March. A basis, my mother said, is nine parts memory and one part somebody willing to be wrong; my grandmother said the memory is the part that changes.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ basis was the whole of the pay, meaning the rate and not the arrangement. The ⑥ basis, meaning the way it was calculated and not any of that, is the only number in a household that everybody knows and nobody checks; a basis, he said, is either what you agree on or the only word that means both an understanding and a rate. She said the rate is the part they argue about.

By 1972 the ⑦ basis had become a paragraph in a letter, and the paragraph had become an argument about what it had meant. The ⑧ basis of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in June, was eleven years of quiet and one disputed winter; a basis, he said, is either the understanding you never wrote or the reason nobody trusted a signature. She said the quiet was the expensive half.

The ⑨ basis I remember is the one about the shop, which was never settled and never forgotten. A ⑩ basis, my mother said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being unwritten; every basis, she said, is a rate that has agreed to look like a promise. He said the promise was never the point.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 基础；基本原则（后来写进信里的那一条）
B. n. 基础（指那份默契，与协议相对）
C. 固定搭配：on a basis 在某种基础上／按某种方式
D. n. 依据（指家里每一条）
E. n. 依据（指 1961 年分家那一条）
F. n. 基准；计价方式（指报酬的计算方式）
G. n. 基准（抽象：计算方式这件事）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a basis he never wrote down
The basis, meaning the understanding and not the agreement
basis was the whole of the pay
The basis, meaning the way it was calculated
the basis had become a paragraph in a letter
The basis of the whole thing
A basis, my mother said in 1974

answers.why: on a basis 意为“按某种方式／在某种基础上”，1954 年祖父按一个他从没写下来的 basis 答应了某件事。
basis 意为“基础、默契”，指那份默契而不是协议，它维持了十一年，第十二年被人争了起来。
basis 指家里每一条依据，那个家里每一条都由年纪最大的人说了算。
basis 指 1961 年分家那一条依据（关于店铺的那一条），到三月还在吵。
basis 意为“基准、计价方式”，指报酬的计算方式，父亲说 basis 就是报酬的全部。
basis 为抽象用法，指计算方式这件事，是一家人人人都知道、却没人去核对的数字。
basis 意为“基本原则”，到 1972 年这个 basis 成了一封信里的一段话。
basis 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，祖父六月写道，整件事权衡下来是十一年的沉默和一个有争议的冬天。
basis 意为“依据、原则”，我记得的是关于店铺的那一条，它从没被解决，也从没被忘掉。
basis 为抽象总称，母亲说依据是唯一会因为没写下来而变好的东西。
